name: EXM_EXP_ITEMIZATION_SUMMARY
description: This table contains the expense itemization details that are used to generate summary information for itemized expenses.

columns.name: ITEMIZATION_SUMMARY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of each itemization summary record.

columns.name: ITEMIZATION_PARENT_EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the parent expense of an itemized expense item.

columns.name: EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the itemized expense item.

columns.name: CARD_EXPENSE_TYPE
columns.description: The card expense type associated with the itemized expense item. This will be a lookup code value from the EXM_CARD_EXPENSE_TYPE lookup type.

columns.name: RECEIPT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of the receipt in the receipt currency.

columns.name: PERSONAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the itemization line is categorized as personal.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the expense occurred or the first day of an expense that spans multiple days.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Last day of an expense that spans multiple days.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
